labels.what: data product with the 5B run-period block: the 5D result's revised covariance
labels.covariance: C_total + C_resp + C_PL5D = C_e + C_model_abs + C_resp + C_PL5D, the revised reported covariance (FD-CT-5B-ADDITION-DECLARATION.md section 1), with C_PL5D = diag(f) P diag(f); C_total_plus_C_resp is the committed product's matrix, written beside it as the variant without the block. Stage G's chi2 is against C_total + C_resp + C_PL5D + V_g
labels.units: f: each cell's integral sum_f xsec_flat_f * vol_f in cm^2/nucleon (S1's meta.integral); each matrix in (cm^2/nucleon)^2; relative sigma: sqrt(diag)/f; box edges as in the H2 definition, whose largest edges (4.5 for p_T, 60 for p_parallel, 100 for E_avail, q3 and W) are the analysis grid's outer edges
labels.block: C_PL,5D: the 5B run-period block (FD-CT-5B-REPORT.md), audited (FD-CT-5B-AUDIT-REPORT.md); added after the data were seen; published with and without. Its sigma rests on three periods: the 68% interval on sigma_true/sigma_hat is [0.73, 2.56]. Noise-dominated cells: R00, R08. Rank 2; undebiased
labels.decision: added under DECISION-20261030 item 2 after the audit's stop condition did not fire (FD-CT-5B-AUDIT-REPORT.md); the decision followed the data; published with and without
labels.context_dr_pair: descriptive; not a reason for the addition: the best detector-response pair (GEANT_Pion#1 with C_resp:meson#1) explains 0.853, 0.560 and 0.617 of PA's, PB's and PC's noise-weighted offset patterns at |a| <= 1.51, reproducing PA's to within noise and not PB's or PC's; pairs have no stop role (FD-CT-5B-AUDIT-REPORT.md section 4)
labels.context_5a_5b: descriptive; not a reason for the addition: 5A's and 5B's mean period offsets agree, PB -2.724% against -2.699% and PC +4.671% against +4.806%, while their patterns about the mean differ beyond the combined noise, with sum (Delta/sigma)^2 of 81.6 and 192.8 over 16 cells (FD-CT-5B-AUDIT-REPORT.md section 6)
not_citable_for: a validated size for C_PL,5D: a block built from the observed differences contains them by construction
the cause of a period difference, or which period is right
labels.not: no reading, claim or release text; whether it ships is Joseph's
labels.cells: R00-R15 are the definition's 16 reporting cells: the 32 H2 boxes (s5p_stage1_inspect.H2_EDGES) after its purity merges (steps, tau 0.1). Stage 1 (state/s5p/stage1/stage1_inspect.json mc.H2) supports 27 of the 32 boxes before merging (the note's 27 supported H2 cells); its unsupported boxes are 2, 6, 10, 14, 17. 28 boxes enter the 16 cells; the definition's unreported boxes are 2, 6, 10, 14; box 17, unsupported alone, enters R09 (17, 19, 21, 23) by the merges
